slots.brief: Ashes at Veskmoor Keep — The funeral bells of Veskmoor toll over a keep already fracturing. Baron Aldric is dead, his debt to the Barony of Corrin unpaid, and his heir unteste
The Forged Ledger — Dust and candle-wax choke the ledger hall. The debt entries to Corrin have been altered — someone padded the sum, and recently.
The Grieving Heir — Lady Ysenne kneels before her father's shrine, more frightened than sorrowful. She needs allies, not mourners.
The Captain's Warning — Captainورs Dovrik warns that Corrin's envoys already ride for Veskmoor, and the garrison is split on whom to follow.
Blades in the Archive — The steward's hand goes to a hidden bell — and armed men pour from the archive shadows.
The Baronial Council — The council gathers beneath the fractured seal of Veskmoor. Corrin's envoy waits at the gate. A decision on the debt must begin to take shape.
The Treaty Vault — Old parchment and older wax seals. Somewhere in this clause-tangled treaty lies a way out — or a way to make one.
Corrin's Envoy — The envoy of Corrin, cloaked in grey and silver, waits with a patience that feels like a blade held to the throat of the barony.
The Price of the Debt — A settlement must be named aloud before the council and the envoy both. Whatever you choose becomes Veskmoor's new truth.
The Ashen Warden's Stand — Corrin's enforcers refuse the settlement and storm the hall, aiming to seize the heir's ancestral guardian before terms can be sealed.
Sealing the Terms — With the enforcers routed, the terms you named must now be made real before the whole of Veskmoor.
A Fragile Peace — Ashmere passes to Corrin under seal and witness. It costs Veskmoor land, but buys it years of uneasy, genuine peace, and Lady Ysenne rules with your n
The Blood Price Paid — The steward's head buys the debt's forgiveness, but the barons whisper of what you were willing to trade for peace. Veskmoor survives, hollowed and wa
A Kingdom Built on Forgery — The false treaty holds — for now. Lady Ysenne rules atop a lie only you and the envoy know, a debt owed forever to your silence.
The Baronies at War — Steel answers where words failed. Corrin's banners darken the passes, and Veskmoor burns behind you as the old feud becomes open war.
Flight from the Ashen Hall — The Warden falls and the hall with it. You flee Veskmoor's ruin with nothing settled, exiles from a succession you could not save.
